# Quantastica

Quantastica is a quantum software startup from Helsinki, Finland, Europe. Quantastica is providing a set of AI-based tools that automate the development of new quantum algorithms. Quantum algorithms designed by robots could solve the hardest computational problems facing modern industry.

## Website

### Website - Home page

- [https://quantastica.com](https://quantastica.com)


### Website - Press Kit page

- [https://quantastica.com/press/](https://quantastica.com/press/)


### Website - Automatic design of quantum algorithms

- [https://quantastica.com/generator/](https://quantastica.com/generator/)


### Website - Quantum simulators page

Quantum computers are rare species expensive to run. We are providing simulators for learning, developing, and testing your quantum algorithms.

- [https://quantastica.com/toaster/](https://quantastica.com/toaster/)


### Website - Careers page

- [https://quantastica.com/careers/](https://quantastica.com/careers/)


## Programming tools

### Programming tools - Quantum Programming Studio

The Quantum Programming Studio is a web based graphical user interface for designing quantum algorithms and executing on simulators or on real quantum computers.

- [Quantum Programming Studio](https://quantum-circuit.com)


### Programming tools - Quantum algorithm development

Quantum Circuit synthesis, transpilation and code converter HTTP REST API

- [https://quantum-circuit.com/openapi.json](https://quantum-circuit.com/openapi.json)


Quantum Circuit synthesis, transpilation and code converter SDK for Python

- [https://pypi.org/project/quantastica-qps-api/](https://pypi.org/project/quantastica-qps-api/)


### Programming tools - Quantum program converter

QConvert - NPM package (command line tool):

- [https://www.npmjs.com/package/q-convert](https://www.npmjs.com/package/q-convert)


QConvert - Web interface

- [https://quantum-circuit.com/qconvert/](https://quantum-circuit.com/qconvert)


### Programming tools - Quantum Circuit Simulator and code converter

NPM package (also packed for web browser)

- [https://www.npmjs.com/package/quantum-circuit](https://www.npmjs.com/package/quantum-circuit)


High performance quantum circuit simulator "Qubit Toaster"

- [https://quantastica.com/toaster/](https://quantastica.com/toaster/)
